approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would authorise extra spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the government's everyday running costs.
It is one of two bills that together provide the additional annual appropriations needed for decisions made after the 2025-26 Mid-Year Economic and Fiscal Outlook.
The bill does not specify the total amount of money it would appropriate or the portfolios it would fund.
Proposes appropriations from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for ordinary annual services.
Forms part of the 2025-26 Supplementary Additional Estimates Appropriation Bills alongside the Appropriation Bill (No. 6) 2025-2026.
Provides funding for government decisions made after the 2025-26 Mid-Year Economic and Fiscal Outlook.
The government and its agencies that receive funding for ordinary annual services.

Tabled proposed expenditure documents for the years ending on 30 June 2027 and 30 June 2026, then moved that they be referred to legislation committees for consideration of the estimates; the question was agreed to.

Moved that two supplementary estimates bills be read a second time and incorporated their speeches in Hansard. The bills seek $2.7 billion and $1.1 billion from the Consolidated Revenue Fund, including funding for Defence, the National Disability Insurance Agency, health, and continued delivery of Inland Rail.
